poiref.empty: Add POIs from the list on the left.
poiref.inline_note: POIs defined directly inside the map data. Editing them in this panel is not supported. You can reorder or delete them, and convert them to GeoJSON.

poiref.layer_ref_note: References an external file and overrides only the display attributes for this map/app. The referenced content itself is not modified.

poiref.layer_key_missing_warning: This element has no layer identifier (id), so the viewer will fail to display this POI data as a whole. Clean it up by converting it to GeoJSON (if convertible) or deleting it.
poiref.missing_source: The referenced POI source was not found (it may have been deleted). Use × to remove this reference.
poiref.convert_success: Created POI draft "{{slug}}". You can edit it from the POI list. The original POI data has not been changed.
poiref.convert_invalid: The conversion result failed validation, so no draft was created.
poiref.convert_too_large: The conversion result is too large to save as a draft.
poiref.add_blocked_note: While external data (such as map-embedded POIs) remains, GeoJSON POIs cannot be added. Delete the external data, or convert it to GeoJSON and then delete it.
poiref.delete_external_body: This external data will be removed from the list (you can undo this). To inspect its contents, convert it to GeoJSON before deleting.
poiref.hide_override_note: When checked, this POI layer starts hidden when this map/app is opened (viewers can turn it on). The POI source itself is not modified.
